description:
FILED s540b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-13), docs/speed-low-hanging-review-s540.md THE LIST.  Code sha 05806e16.

WHERE: lib/Storable.pm `dclone` (line 584): `_do_retrieve(_do_store($self, 0), ...)` -- every dclone serialises the whole structure into Storable's binary format (pack-heavy) and parses it back.  lib/Clone.pm (`clone`, the #3826 pure-Perl shim) already does a recursive copy with a seen-table (shared references kept, blessing kept).

MEASUREMENT (scratch/s540b/shim/m-dclone.pl vs m-clone.pl: 3,000 copies of `{a => 1, b => [1,2,3], c => {d => 'x', e => [4,5]}}`; whole run, best of 5; legs/leg4.log has the quiet numbers): exploratory PCL dclone 1.83 s vs Clone::clone 0.33 s (both incl. ~0.15 s start-up); shimbench dclone 498 us a call vs perl XS 1.9 us.  sb-sprof of m-dclone: %make-p-box 10.5 %, box-set 6.7 %, %p-flatten-list 5.2 %, cl-ppcre 4 % -- the serialiser's per-item work.
Prevalence: 48 dclone sites in 18 files (+ 45 freeze/thaw sites in 6 files, which keep the format path).

THE FIX (lib/ only, a plainer Perl body): dclone walks the structure directly (Clone's algorithm) and falls back to freeze+thaw ONLY when it meets what the format path must handle: an object whose class has STORABLE_freeze / STORABLE_thaw / STORABLE_attach hooks, a CODE ref (dies "Can't store CODE items" unless $Storable::Deparse / $Storable::Eval), a GLOB, a tied container, a regexp object (Storable 3.x stores them).  Shared and circular references must stay shared (the seen-table).

BAR: the Storable dist tests that run on the board (one-file runs), the Storable guard rows in Pl/t, new rows: shared refs stay shared, a cycle copies, blessing kept, a hook class goes through its hooks, a CODE ref dies with perl's message; the m-dclone measurement reproduced.

DO NOT: alias dclone to Clone::clone wholesale (hooks, CODE refs and tied containers differ).

=== QUIET NUMBERS (s540b legs/leg4.log, load 1.1-1.4) === dclone: PCL 420,045 ns a call, perl XS 1,707; whole run of 3,000 copies: dclone 1.390 s, Clone::clone 0.084 s, perl dclone 0.013 s (best of 5).

=== s540 (2026-11-13) === scheduled in s540/s540e-prompt.md member 1.  The USER asked whether dclone does not NEED to serialise: no -- the result is a structure equal to the input that shares nothing with it; real Storable's C code goes through its in-memory format because that is the code it has.  The format path stays for hooks, CODE refs, globs, tied containers, regexp objects.

=== RULED (the USER, s540, 2026-11-13) === if dclone works, use the FASTEST implementation: the batch measures the Perl walk against one generic runtime deep-copy primitive (builtin:: seam, shared with the Clone shim) and ships the faster one that passes the differential probe against real Storable.
subject: PERF (s540b, measured): Storable's shim implements dclone as freeze-to-a-string + thaw (pure-Perl Storable format) -- ~560 us for a small nested hash, perl's XS ~2 us; the Clone shim's recursive copy of the same data is ~60 us
